intro: 'Not Dead Yet' is an urgent plea from Eralya, a mortally wounded night elf discovered after a disastrous mission toward the Oracle Tree. Overwhelmed by vicious harpies, she begs travelers to deliver word of her patrol's fate to Byancie in Dolanaar. It highlights the deadly threats encroaching upon the woodland paths of Teldrassil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My sisters and I... Were dispatched... Oracle Tree...
I may not have long... No one coming. Please... Byancie... In Dolanaar...

clips.title: Completion
paras: The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well.
We must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.
